node.statement: For every row j, its fixed vertex representation p_j=sum_v lambda_jv p_v is a convex combination over geometrically distinct row vertices. Applying lem-residual-upper to C, the positive weights b_v=lambda_jv, no negative terms, m=sum_v lambda_jv=1, and q=p_j gives the depth-convexity bound d_j<=sum_v lambda_jv d_v.
